title_sq: Okazion Investimi! Tek Vasil Shanto, Shitet Ambient Biznesi Bar-Kafe, Buze Unaze!
description_sq: Okazion Investimi! Prane Shkolles "Vasil Shanto", Shitet Ambient Biznesi "Bar Kafe", Buze Unaze. Ambienti eshte totalisht i investuar per te qene funksional si Bar-Kafe, ne nje pozicion strategjik afer institucioneve, shkollave dhe zyrave. Strukturohet ne nje ambient te brendshem Open Space, ambient gatimi, dy tualete dhe nje verande e jashtme. Hapesira lejon mundesine per te zhvilluar aktivitetin ne disa dimensione duke marre parasysh dhe levizjen teper te madhe te kembesoreve. Aktualisht eshte i dhene me qira 2000 euro ne muaj me qira afatgjate.
title_en: Investment Opportunity! At Vasil Shanto, Bar-Cafe Business Environment for sale, Ringside!
description_en: Investment Opportunity! Near "Vasil Shanto" School, "Bar Kafe" Business premises for sale, Buze Unaze. The environment is totally invested to be functional as a Bar-Cafe, in a strategic position close to institutions, schools and offices. It is structured in an internal Open Space environment, a cooking area, two toilets and an external veranda. The space allows the possibility to develop the activity in several dimensions, taking into account the excessive movement of pedestrians. It is currently rented for 2000 euros per month for long-term rent.
